text:
alex: bringing up mellowfox-34b (int4) canary — seeing sporadic OOMs during multi-turn long-context tests. Anyone else?

mira: yep, reproduced on perf-dev. Batch 8 + max_new_tokens=1024 triggers most failures.

cheng: looked at allocator traces - fragmentation + slow slab reclamation. stack hint: serve/runtime/alloc.go:423 -> kv_cache.grow -> evict_noop.

sam: quick numbers from yesterday's canary run: p50 220ms, p95 450ms, oom_count 12/1k requests (mostly >512-token gen).

julia: quality check: quantize_v2 -> int4 gives slight drop on long-conditioned summarization (rouge-L -1.8 absolute). Not huge but noticeable on user prompts.

tia: hypothesis: prefetch + large default max_new_tokens means KV cache grows uncontrolled, causing fragmentation and then OOM on microbursts.

alex: proposal (quick mitigation): set model default max_new_tokens=256 for mellowfox-34b/int4; disable prefetch for canary; enable slab compaction; soft-evict threshold -> 0.6; microbatch size -> 4.

mira: +1. Also enable compact-slabs=true and warmstart_slots=2 on the canary pool.

cheng: I'll run two experiments in parallel:
A) config-A: max_new=256, prefetch=off, compact-slabs=true, microbatch=4
B) config-B: same as A but with int8 fallback for requests that have expected tokens >512 (runtime routing)

sam: can you paste the small eval you ran?

cheng: paste from quick run:
```
model: mellowfox-34b-int4
config: baseline (max_new=1024, prefetch=on)
ooms: 12/1000
latency_p95: 450ms
rouge-L: 31.2

config: A (max_new=256, prefetch=off, compact-slabs)
ooms: 1/1000
latency_p95: 420ms
rouge-L: 30.9
```

julia: delta for A is -0.3 rouge-L. tradeoff seems acceptable if it fixes OOMs. Need PM signoff for shipped default.

tia: request: run full 1k eval against the customer prompt set. If regression >0.5, fallback rule -> int8 for >512 tokens (auto-route).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created canary rollout `mellowfox-34b/int4-cushion-v1` with 5% traffic -> /deploy/1753216600 :white_check_mark:

cheng: I'll add KV_size and slab_frag_ratio graphs to model dashboard (alerts on slab_frag_ratio > 0.25).

alex: plan: run config-A for 24h A/B; if A meets oom_rate < 0.2% and quality delta <= 0.5, merge as hosted default. Sam to schedule and watch alerts.

sam: scheduling A/B; will set oom_rate alert at 0.1% and p95 regression alert at +10%. also adding a canary log exporter for traces on OOMs.

mira: also doing a small quant-calibration sweep (100 samples) to see if int4 quant tuning can recover the -0.3 rouge-L. if successful we can relax fallback.

julia: if sweep fails, next step is per-layer selective fp16/int8 for MLP blocks 10-14 — reduces quality loss for long context.

alex: nice. keep thread updated. thanks :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started at 1753216620, 5% traffic -> monitor: /dash/mellowfox-34b/int4-cushion-v1
